Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GBPUAT Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A1. The last date to submit the application for Research Fellow posts at GBPUAT is 21 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are sent via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GBPUAT Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A2. There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Fellow post in the GBPUAT Recruitment 2026. This is a contractual position offering a good opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for GBPUAT Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: A3. The application mode for GBPUAT Research Fellow posts is Email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Fellow post at GBPUAT?
faq.answer: A4. The selected candidate for the Research Fellow post at GBPUAT will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month. This is a fixed remuneration for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: A5. Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Food Technology, Horticulture, or Postharvest Technology to be eligible for the Research Fellow position at GBPUAT.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for GBPUAT Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A6. No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the GBPUAT Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. All candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: A7. The selection process for the Research Fellow post at GBPUAT primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: A8. The job location for the Research Fellow post is Pantnagar, Uttarakhand, with Pincode 263145. The G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology is located there.

faq.question: Q9. When is the interview date for GBPUAT Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: A9. The interview for the GBPUAT Research Fellow Recruitment is scheduled for 22 August 2026. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for exact time and venue details.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology?
faq.answer: A10. The official website for G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology (GBPUAT) is https://www.gbpuat.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and updates.
